fields.body:
## User Stories

- As a viewer-api maintainer, I need a repo-local rule workspace so viewer-specific guidance can evolve independently of the parent repo.
- As a parent-repo maintainer, I need viewer-api to publish a reusable workspace summary that can be included in memory-viewers targets.
- As a reviewer, I need repo-local generation commands so I can validate viewer-api documentation without depending on the parent workspace.
